description:
More Bar Missions (v0.0.6)Never see an empty bar again!

download here

requires* LunaLib

A mod to increases the frequency of bar missions and ensure every market has some missions.

support all recurring vanilla missionsCan be freely added and removed from saves!

If you have "-Xverify:none" in your vmparams then LunaLib is optional

img

[close]detailsSince I had to delve into the bar manager code for my other mod, I figured I should make use of that knowledge.

Have you ever had an experience, where you don't like the missions offered in the bar, so you visit the next one, and then you still don't like the missions offered, so you visit the next one again.  Then at some point you realized that the bar is empty with nothing to do.

Well if you did, then YOU'RE PLAYING THE GAME WRONG!

The bar manager code works fine if you spend most of your time traveling and doing stuff, and significant amount of time passes between each bar visit.  If you visit bars too often, then bad things happen.

To start with, there are various limits defined in

bar_events.csv

, and only half of the mission can be active at any given time.

Then, every time you see a bar mission being offered, that mission locks itself onto that market for a period of 30-40 days, during which no other markets will offer that mission.  However, since the mission is active on the original market, it takes up one of the active missions slots (only half of the missions can be active at any given time).

And if you accept the mission, then the mission cannot be offered again for 60-90 days.  But if you don't accept the mission and try to wait out the 30-40 days, then the game adds another 15-20 days delay before the mission can be offered on another market.  So on average, if you see a mission but don't like it, then it won't appear again for 92.5 days, even though it'll be taking up one of the active mission slots during most of that time.

So you don't actually need to visit that many markets before you run out of mission.  In vanilla there are 25 bar missions (excluding the old commodity delivery mission that's governed by a different code path), and each bar shows 1-3 missions by default, so that works out to just

SEVEN

bar visits.

And then it gets worse.

Every time you visit the bar, the game locks the missions offered on that bar for a period of 20-40 days,

even if there are no missions offered!

So once you run out of missions, and you try to remedy that situation by visiting more markets, you made the problem worse by locking up more markets from having missions.

So what does this mod do?  It adds a new bar manager that runs alongside the vanilla one, and uses the new one for the 22 bar missions defined in

bar_events.csv

.  Unlike vanilla, each market determines what missions are offered independently of each other, so nothing prevents multiple of the same missions from being offered and accepted.  Also if the manager cannot find enough missions, then the limits defined in

bar_events.csv

are treated as suggestions instead of hard limits.

If the mod still doesn't give you enough missions, you can modify the limits in

MoreBarMissions\data\config\settings.json

- guard against unexpected mission creation exceptions

- treat bar_events.csv missions with very large timeouts (>= 1000000000f) as 1 off missions

- recompile for Java 17 and 0.98a-RC5

Version 0.0.5 (2024-02-02)

- changed version string to 0.97a-RC6

- note: you might need "-Xverify:none" in your vmparams if you don't want to enable LunaLib and you ran into

"java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: lunalib/lunaSettings/LunaSettingsListener" issue

- added $market.noBar check

- make it less likely that priority events will crowd out non-priority ones

Version 0.0.4 (2023-12-06)

- made the mod compatible with Java7, update if you run into "java.lang.NoSuchMethodError: java.lang.String.join"

Version 0.0.3 (2023-12-05):

- updated SDK to 1.8

- improved compatibility/consistency and added support for old style bar events

- added Luna Settings support from LunaLib as an optional dependency

- added support for version checker

Version 0.0.2 (2023-08-11):

- fixed a crash that can happen with visiting the rift gate from ExiledSpace and similar markets

Version 0.0.1 (2023-05-28):

- modified the event frequency such that events picked at less than their expected frequency gets a probability boost compared to pure random;

this also tends to cycle through the events more then pure random

Version 0.0.0 (2023-05-22):

- initial release

- tried my best to make an utility mod that you can safely remove, but don't blame me if I F it up

- increase MmmBmBarEvents if you want to see more events per bar; decrease MmmBmAddActiveCoolDownDays if you want them to refresh faster
